items.followUp: What is the purpose of the title element in the head section of an HTML document?

rubric.why: The head section contains information about the document rather than the webpage’s main content.
rubric.description: Information contained in the head section
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the head section contains information about the HTML document.

rubric.why: These are the opening and closing tags that enclose the head section.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for giving both the opening and closing head tags.

modelAnswer: The head section contains information about an HTML document, such as its title, that is not displayed as the main content of the webpage.
It is written between the <head> and </head> tags.

items.followUp: Name the four-layer TCP/IP model and briefly state the function of each layer.

rubric.why: The TCP/IP model is a framework that describes network communication using layers.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying it as a layered framework for network communication.

rubric.why: The application layer provides network services, while the transport layer manages end-to-end communication and data delivery.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming both layers and giving their functions.

rubric.why: The Internet layer uses IP addressing and routing to move packets between networks.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming the Internet layer and stating its IP addressing and routing role.

rubric.why: The data link and physical layers prepare data for a local link and transmit bits over the physical medium.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming both layers and describing transmission over the physical medium.

modelAnswer: The TCP/IP model is a layered framework that describes how data is communicated over networks.
Application layer: provides network services used by applications, such as web and email services.
Transport layer: provides end to end communication and manages the delivery of data between devices.
Internet layer: uses IP addressing and routing to move packets between networks.
Data link layer: organises data for transmission over a local network link.
Physical layer: transmits bits as signals over the physical communication medium.

items.followUp: What is an algorithm, and how does it help in solving a problem?

rubric.why: Problem solving follows an orderly process rather than relying on guesswork.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for describing problem solving as a systematic or step-by-step process.

rubric.why: The purpose of problem solving is to find a solution to the problem.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the process aims to find a solution.

modelAnswer: Problem solving is a systematic process of understanding a problem and finding a solution to it.

items.followUp: Convert the binary number 1011₂ to decimal and explain the place values used.

rubric.why: The binary number system has a base of two.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that binary has base 2.

rubric.why: Binary uses only the digits 0 and 1, and its place values are powers of two.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that binary uses 0 and 1 or that its place values are powers of 2.

modelAnswer: The binary number system has base 2 and uses only the digits 0 and 1.
Each position in a binary number has a place value that is a power of 2.
